3×3 판에 X와 O가 번갈아 한 칸씩 둔다. 가로·세로·대각선 중 한: On a 3×3 board, X and O take turns playing in one square at a time. Whoever first places 3 of their own marks in one horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line wins. If no one has won by the time the board is full, it is a draw.
3×3 판에 X와 O가 번갈아 한 칸씩 둔다. 가로·세로 중 한 줄에 자: On a 3×3 board, X and O take turns playing in one square at a time. Whoever first places 3 of their own marks in one horizontal or vertical line wins. A diagonal does not count as a line. If no one has won by the time the board is full, it is a draw.
3×3 판에 X와 O가 번갈아 한 칸씩 둔다. 가로·세로·대각선 중 한: On a 3×3 board, X and O take turns playing in one square at a time. Whoever first places 3 of their own marks in one horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line, or first takes three squares among the four corners (A1, A3, C1, C3), wins. If no one has won by the time the board is full, it is a draw.
판은 행 A~C, 열 1~3으로 적고 빈칸은 \".\"이다. 좌표는 \": The board is written with rows A to C and columns 1 to 3, and an empty square is ".". A coordinate is written by joining the row and the column, as in "B2".
